title: Jurisdiction
description: One jurisdiction with its validity interval and succession links (PROCUREMENT_PLAN §2.2 Table 6), built from curated/jurisdictions.csv and curated/iso_aliases.csv

code.description: ISO 3166-2:IN code of a current State or Union territory (e.g. IN-MH), IN-CENTRAL for the Union, or IN-HIST-<NAME> for a historical unit

name.description: Name, the last one borne for a renamed jurisdiction

other_names.description: Former or alternate names (e.g. Madras for Tamil Nadu), for mapping names to codes

valid_from.description: First day; null when it existed before 1956-11-01 (earlier history is not modelled)

valid_to.description: Day it ceased to exist (exclusive); null while it exists

successor_of.description: Codes of the jurisdictions it was formed from; each ends on this one's valid_from

inherited_laws_from.description: Codes of the jurisdictions whose laws continued in (part of) its territory

iso_code.description: Its ISO 3166-2:IN code; null for the Union and historical units

iso_status.description: Whether iso_code was checked against the pinned ISO list (none: no ISO code)

iso_aliases.description: Former ISO 3166-2:IN codes that resolve to this jurisdiction (e.g. IN-TG for IN-TS)

legal_basis.description: Provisions of corpus Acts that establish the row, e.g. A1960-11 s. 2(a)
